WITH legacy_groups AS (
                SELECT
                    mcm.collection_id AS tmdb_collection_id,
                    'tmdb:collection:' || mcm.collection_id::text AS stable_key,
                    COALESCE(
                        NULLIF(MIN(mcm.name), ''),
                        'TMDB Collection ' || mcm.collection_id::text
                    ) AS title,
                    MIN(NULLIF(btrim(mcm.poster_path), '')) AS poster_path,
                    MIN(NULLIF(btrim(mcm.backdrop_path), '')) AS backdrop_path,
                    COUNT(DISTINCT mr.tmdb_id)::bigint AS local_member_count,
                    COUNT(DISTINCT mr.tmdb_id) FILTER (WHERE mf.is_available)::bigint
                        AS available_member_count
                FROM movie_collection_membership mcm
                JOIN movie_references mr ON mr.id = mcm.movie_id
                LEFT JOIN media_files mf ON mf.id = mr.file_id
                GROUP BY mcm.collection_id
            ), definition_inputs AS (
                SELECT
                    uuidv7() AS id,
                    stable_key,
                    stable_key AS external_key,
                    tmdb_collection_id,
                    title,
                    poster_path,
                    backdrop_path,
                    local_member_count,
                    available_member_count,
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'type', 'types',
                        'media_types', jsonb_build_array('movie')
                    ) AS media_scope,
                    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
                        'source', 'tmdb',
                        'provider_image_path', COALESCE(poster_path, backdrop_path)
                    )) AS artwork,
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'prefer_backdrop', backdrop_path IS NOT NULL
                    ) AS theme,
                    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
                        'source', 'tmdb',
                        'imported_from', 'movie_collection_membership',
                        'external_id', tmdb_collection_id::text,
                        'generated_by', 'ferrex.tmdb_collection_import',
                        'last_refreshed_at', NOW()
                    )) AS provenance
                FROM legacy_groups
            ), upsert_definitions AS (
                INSERT INTO collection_definitions (
                    id,
                    stable_key,
                    external_key,
                    title,
                    description,
                    kind,
                    source,
                    owner_type,
                    owner_display_name,
                    scope,
                    visibility,
                    presentation,
                    media_scope,
                    duplicate_policy,
                    artwork,
                    theme,
                    provenance,
                    contract_version,
                    revision,
                    etag
                )
                SELECT
                    id,
                    stable_key,
                    external_key,
                    title,
                    NULL::text,
                    'tmdb_collection',
                    'tmdb',
                    'external',
                    'TMDB',
                    'global',
                    'public',
                    'grid',
                    media_scope,
                    'deduplicate_media',
                    artwork,
                    theme,
                    provenance,
                    $1,
                    0,
                    concat('collection:', id::text, ':v0')
                FROM definition_inputs
                ON CONFLICT (stable_key) DO UPDATE SET
                    external_key = EXCLUDED.external_key,
                    title = EXCLUDED.title,
                    kind = EXCLUDED.kind,
                    source = EXCLUDED.source,
                    owner_type = EXCLUDED.owner_type,
                    owner_display_name = EXCLUDED.owner_display_name,
                    scope = EXCLUDED.scope,
                    visibility = EXCLUDED.visibility,
                    presentation = EXCLUDED.presentation,
                    media_scope = EXCLUDED.media_scope,
                    duplicate_policy = EXCLUDED.duplicate_policy,
                    artwork = EXCLUDED.artwork,
                    theme = EXCLUDED.theme,
                    provenance = EXCLUDED.provenance,
                    archived_at = NULL,
                    deleted_at = NULL,
                    revision = collection_definitions.revision + 1,
                    etag = concat(
                        'collection:',
                        collection_definitions.id::text,
                        ':v',
                        collection_definitions.revision + 1
                    ),
                    updated_at = NOW()
                RETURNING id, stable_key, title
            ), definition_sources AS (
                SELECT
                    ud.id AS collection_id,
                    lg.tmdb_collection_id,
                    lg.title,
                    lg.poster_path,
                    lg.backdrop_path,
                    lg.local_member_count,
                    lg.available_member_count
                FROM upsert_definitions ud
                JOIN legacy_groups lg ON lg.stable_key = ud.stable_key
            ), upsert_sources AS (
                INSERT INTO collection_sources (
                    collection_id,
                    provider,
                    source_kind,
                    source_key,
                    source_scope_key,
                    external_owner,
                    title,
                    refreshed_at,
                    payload
                )
                SELECT
                    collection_id,
                    'tmdb',
                    'tmdb_collection',
                    tmdb_collection_id::text,
                    'global',
                    'TMDB',
                    title,
                    NOW(),
                    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
                        'tmdb_collection_id', tmdb_collection_id::text,
                        'poster_path', poster_path,
                        'backdrop_path', backdrop_path,
                        'local_member_count', local_member_count,
                        'available_local_member_count', available_member_count
                    ))
                FROM definition_sources
                ON CONFLICT (provider, source_kind, source_key, source_scope_key)
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        collection_id = EXCLUDED.collection_id,
                        title = EXCLUDED.title,
                        refreshed_at = NOW(),
                        payload = EXCLUDED.payload,
                        updated_at = NOW()
                RETURNING id
            )
            SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "count!"
            FROM upsert_sources
